title: Stabilization of Trochanteric Fracture Using a Screw-plate TRAUMAX
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the stabilization of trochanteric fracture using a screw-plate TRAUMAX
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Man or woman
* Age \> 18
* with a trochanteric fracture whom surgeon advised the use of a screw-plate TRAUMAX

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with an acute infection
* Patient with a major osseous deterioration which not allows a correct support of the screws in the bone
* Patient with an ASA score of 4 or 5
* Patient whom the time between the fracture and the surgery could be higher than 8 days
study_population: Patient with a trochanteric fracture whom surgeon advised the use of a screw-plate TRAUMAX
